name: Lisley McDowell
original_name: リズリー・マクダウェル
source:
Likes: [url=/c39583]Yuuto[/url]
Dislikes: Humans during daytime

Lisley is the girl who actually summoned Yuuto and a Nightmare (succubus). She constantly boasts about her powers and pretends to be stronger and more headstrong than she actually is in order to hide her lack of confidence in regards to her own abilities. She also acts more experienced in regards to sexual things, while in reality she's a virgin.

While her powers as a Nightmare haven't developed much yet, she is stronger than the average human.
